The '''Lanthanide Mine''' was a mine located in the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] that at one point was used for [[Lanthanide/Legends|lanthanide]] production. It was eventually abandoned and by c. [[3643 BBY]] was inhabited by the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] of [[Ukunuku]] nets, led by a [[Night Herald]]. Several members of the [[House of Thul]] were held captive in the mines, and at least one them - [[Daria Thul]] - became a [[Joiner]].
